summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a Form 6-K announcing a private placement of 8,571,429 ADSs with Series A-1 and A-2 warrants at a combined price of $0.70 per ADS, expected to close June 22, 2026. Gross proceeds are ~$6 million, with potential warrant exercise adding ~$13.4 million. H.C. Wainwright is the placement agent. The filing is a routine capital raise and does not constitute a special situation under the defined categories.
